_doc: Labeled routing eval. 'accept' = any of these skills counts as a hit. class_dev / class_holdout_v4: miss-class variation sets (A common-word names, B security intent, C SEO intent, D same-category extras); pass = an accepted skill is suggested (if any listed), no 'forbid' skill appears, and at most 'max_names' names. class_holdout_v4 and class_neg_holdout_v4 were frozen before 0.4.0 tuning. holdout_v3/v2/v1 are earlier holdouts minus prompts moved to dev after tuning on them. silent items must produce no hint. class_neg_* are look-alikes that must not fire their class (A: a skill matched only through everyday words in its name; B: security skills; C: seo-* skills; D: image-to-code / image generation); other skills may still fire. deep: deep-mode prompts (task + trigger phrase); accept [] means the hint must say no installed skill matches. deep_holdout was frozen before the 1.2.0 deep-mode tuning and must not be tuned against.
